origin.summary: Closeout observation from the repository's public synthetic benefits correspondence exchange.

sharing.public_release_basis: Invented correspondence facts, declared public policy excerpts, and repository-generated evaluation artifacts only.

mission.title: Treat accessibility as a release gate, not a finishing task
mission.beneficiary: Applicants and recipients who need understandable or accessible correspondence
mission.baseline: A manual quality review can confirm the main explanation while a declared format or language need remains incomplete.
mission.intended_outcome: Material claims, recourse, authority, and declared communication needs remain jointly visible before a human sends correspondence.

challenge.failure_shape: Five exact cases make the pilot look ready while one declared-language case still fails the accessibility oracle.
challenge.decision_point: Whether to continue unchanged, remediate the branch, or stop the affected communication path.

evidence.title: Synthetic acceptance transcript
evidence.scope: Six public synthetic correspondence cases submitted by the illustrative responder.
evidence.limitations: The transcript was not independently reproduced and does not represent production correspondence.
evidence.verification: The local assessor recomputed exact outcome, reason, authority, and evidence fields.

evidence.title: Declared communication-needs test note
evidence.limitations: This is not an accessibility conformance report or affected-user study.
evidence.verification: The lesson links only to the two declared accessibility cases in the public exchange.

outcome.summary: The pilot preserved every critical gate but exposed a noncritical accessibility failure that aggregate success could have hidden.
outcome.observed_change: The team kept the affected language branch out of the ready path and added an exact accessibility regression gate before continuing.
outcome.human_decision: The accountable program reviewer chose remediation and retest rather than treating five of six exact cases as sufficient release evidence.

metrics.interpretation: The single miss remains visible and is not averaged away.
Critical evidence, remedy, and human-authority gates remained intact.

reusable_practice.title: Conjunctive communication readiness
reusable_practice.action: Require the main explanation, recourse, protected authority, and each declared communication need to pass independently before the affected path is marked ready.
reusable_practice.rationale: A high aggregate score can conceal exclusion in a small but consequential branch.
contract_considerations: Which communication needs are represented in intended-environment tests?
Which failed branch blocks only that path, and which failure stops the entire workflow?
How will affected users and accessibility specialists participate in validation?

contexts: Workflows with declared format or language needs
prerequisites: Declared communication needs in the test input
limitations: No real applicant data or production channel was used

commercial.pricing_insight: Accessibility regression volume must be included in pilot, expected, and surge cost assumptions rather than treated as unpriced exception work.
commercial.government_data_and_ip: The reference pilot uses invented records and preserves agency ownership of evaluation artifacts.
commercial.portability: Communication-needs cases, results, prompts, and evidence ledgers must export in documented formats.
commercial.exit_insight: An exit rehearsal should preserve unresolved accessibility cases and their human owners.

privacy.data_used: Invented case facts and declared communication needs.
privacy.data_minimization: The scenario declares only the communication need required for the test and does not infer disability or collect unrelated records.
privacy.retention: The public lesson retains synthetic artifacts and aggregate results only.
privacy.privacy_performance_tradeoff: No real-person data was introduced to expand test coverage; the resulting lesson is narrower and safer to share.

authority.stop_or_change_decision: A human reviewer held the affected branch for remediation and retest.

policy_dependencies.dependency: Human oversight, remedies, testing, monitoring, and cease-use boundaries.
Performance requirements, testing, pricing transparency, portability, and lifecycle monitoring.
Systematic collection and safe reuse of evidence-linked acquisition lessons.

disclaimers: This lesson is not a source-selection decision or vendor comparison.
This lesson is not a certification, accessibility conformance report, or government approval.
An accountable official must determine applicability, disclosure, reuse, and every protected action.
